metadata.description: Community plugin for adding the Thmanyah (ثمانية) Arabic font family to web projects.

plugins.name: thmanyah-font
plugins.description: Add the Thmanyah Arabic font family (Sans, Serif Display, Serif Text) to a web project via npm or the jsDelivr CDN, with a /thmanyah-font:setup command and per-project settings.
